items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Doubles Down on U.S. Housing
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway nearly doubled its stake in home builder Lennar, adding to its bet on the U.S. housing industry, while confirming its position in Italian web-services firm Bending Spoons.

items.title: Here's What Berkshire Hathaway Bought and Sold in Q3
items.summary: Berkshire mostly continued where it left off in Q2. Here are all the stocks that Greg Abel & Co. added to the portfolio — and the ones they sold, too.

items.title: Berkshire Boosts Stake in Lennar, Doubling Down on Its U.S. Housing Bet
items.summary: The conglomerate formerly run by Warren Buffett also trimmed stakes in Capital One and Nucor during the September quarter.

items.title: 3 Building-Materials Stocks Rallying While Homebuilders Struggle to Find Buyers
items.summary: As high mortgage rates stall home sales and new construction, Masco, Carlisle, and James Hardie are gaining from rising repair, renovation, and roofing demand, each posting strong Q3 and Q4 2026 earnings.

items.title: Existing-Home Sales Fall to Lowest Level Since 2010 as Mortgage Rates Take Their Toll
items.summary: October home sales were the slowest in 16 years according to the National Association of Realtors. High mortgage rates are keeping potential buyers on the sidelines.

items.title: Democrats propose $1,000 down payment FHA program for first-time homebuyers
items.summary: Investing.com -- A Democratic-aligned policy group wants to cut the barrier to homeownership to $1,000, and it says taxpayers wouldn’t pay for it.
